title: Stop Saying "Very Happy"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very happy". Try one of these instead:
• Thrilled: thrilled with the result
• Delighted: delighted to see you
• Overjoyed: overjoyed at the news
• Ecstatic: ecstatic fans
• Elated: elated after the win

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.
